skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems in real-world settings.
Demonstrate effective communication skills in a professional environment, including written and oral presentations.
Conduct independent research and develop conclusions on specialized topics.
Work effectively in both independent and team settings.
Analyze and manage human resource activities in an organization.
Show leadership in planning, coordinating, and completing tasks.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and propose solutions to complex issues.
Manage and complete projects with a focus on planning, execution, and evaluation.
